outcome: Oxygenated hemoglobin (HbO2) levels measured by near-infrared spectroscopy
cohort: Newborns undergoing heart auscultation (non-painful reference) and hip examination
finding: Neonatal hip examinations were found to be painful, as evidenced by higher pain scores, increased oxygenated hemoglobin levels, and changes in galvanic skin response compared to heart auscultation.
